name: clean-save-report-prose-pin
body: The no-op save's report is pinned as exact coordinator stdout text (`Session saved: no pending changes`, and `Session saved: 1 change(s) in one commit` for the one real save), with the two no-ops counted by occurrence rather than merely present. Upgrade to structured reply fields when the session's save reporting becomes machine-readable instead of prose; until then a reworded report line breaks this test by design.
